main_text.p: 4 Hos in proximo gradu sequentes dicuntur sobrinorum liberi, hoc est, fratris aut fororis pronepotes, aut proneptes: & sic deinceps

§ de abnepotibus & abneptibus. Nisi quòd singuli horum uno gradu longiùs à Petrucio vel hypothetico absunt, quàm numeri hîc assignati significant, & quinti hîc in sexto sint gradu vel generatione, ut & arbor præfixa ostendit.
In linea verò transversâ inæquali ascendente Petrucius noster vel hypotheticus habet ab agnatis, hoc est, à masculino latere, vel à patre,
main_text.l: fratrem, qui est patruus, des vat-ters bruder.
sororem, quæ est amita, quasi tertia à me, des vatters schwester.
fratrem, qui est propatruus, vel patruus major.
sororem, quæ est proamita, vel amita major.
fratrem, qui est abpatruus, vel patruus maximus.
sororem, quæ est abamita, vel amita maxima.
main_text.p: A cognatis verò, hoc est, à fœminino latere, vel à matre,

page.notes: The section sign at the start of the second paragraph is printed as a long-s-like mark; read as §, uncertain. The margin on the right belongs to the neighbouring page and was not transcribed. The 'sobrinorum' and 'fororis' readings are clear enough, but the initial letters were printed in a form close to f; checked as s.
